items.title: Leslie Gourse interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 9, 1996
items.q: Mahalia Jackson is just coming out, also with Franklin Watts.

ctx.x: Do you get to go to Paris in the —

I go, yeah, I go pretty often on a holiday. And then I’m doing a couple of other stories. But then I’ve done four books in a series on jazz history by instrument — by singers, pianists, bassists and horn players are done. Now I have to do guitarists and drummers. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-

And that’s for a company called Franklin Watts. I have three biographies out on Aretha Franklin, Billie Holiday and Mahalia Jackson is just coming out, also with Franklin Watts. And I had a book out on Dizzy Gillespie and the birth of bebop for kids, and by kids I mean teenagers. And now facing me I have this as I said the drum book and the guitar book, and I just did an anthology and I’m finishing up the details on writings about Billie Holiday by other writers. I did the introduction and I’m going to do one on…
